title: Saudia Permitted Items in Baggage and Cabin | Saudia
desc: See Saudia permitted items you can pack in checked and carry on baggage. Check the list before flying and ensure a smooth journey with Saudia now.
h1: Saudia Permitted Items in Baggage and Cabin | Saudia
html:
Permitted items

Items You Can Safely Carry Onboard

Excess Baggage with Conditions or Limitations

If a guest needs to transport a single item weighing more than 32 kg (70 lb) that cannot be separated into smaller pieces (such as musical instruments, sports equipment, or medical devices), they must inform Saudia in advance so the necessary arrangements can be made.

Zamzam Water Allowance

  • Saudia accepts one complimentary Zamzam water package (one gallon, not exceeding 5 liters) from the Sogia factory for all guests departing from Prince Mohammed bin Abdulaziz Airport in Madinah. It is accepted only as checked baggage.
  • Guests traveling from other domestic airports to domestic or international destinations (except King Abdulaziz International Airport – Terminal 1) may carry one Zamzam water package as part of their free checked baggage allowance. Any excess weight will be charged according to standard excess baggage rates.
  • In line with safety regulations, Zamzam water bottles are not permitted inside checked baggage.

Electrical Devices Acceptance

Electrical devices such as televisions and household appliances are accepted as checked baggage based on the applicable baggage allowances, weights, and dimensions for Saudia domestic and international flights.

Additional charges apply if the weight or size exceeds the allowed limits.

Acceptance of Sports Equipment

  • Sports equipment is accepted as part of the free checked baggage allowance if it falls within the approved size limits.
  • If not included within the free allowance, excess baggage fees apply.
  • Sports equipment must be packed in protective cases with reinforced, shock-absorbing materials.
  • Sports equipment exceeding approved dimensions may be accepted on board Boeing B777 and B787 aircraft.

Excess Baggage Charges for Sports Equipment

  • International flights:

    1. A fee of USD 100 applies to items exceeding the approved dimensions of 158 cm (62 in) up to 205 cm (80 in).
    2. An additional USD 67 applies to items exceeding 205 cm (80 in) up to 300 cm (118 in), totaling USD 167.
    3. Items exceeding 300 cm (118 in) or weighing more than 32 kg (70 lb) must be transported via Cargo.
    4. For travel to or from Canada, an additional CAD 89 applies per oversized piece, totaling CAD 189.

  • Domestic flights:

    1. A fee of SAR 100 applies to each item exceeding 158 cm (62 in) and less than 205 cm (80 in).
    2. An additional SAR 100 applies to items between 205 cm (80 in) and 300 cm (118 in), totaling SAR 200.
    3. Items exceeding 300 cm (118 in) or weighing more than 32 kg (70 lb) must be transported through Cargo.
